text: AYS staff was a pleasure to work with. When I called, they were already familiar with the setup of our venue and had worked with our caterers many times before. They were always available by phone and responded quickly to emails. From the start, they were incredibly patient in explaining all the options and offering advice on everything—from what drinks to buy to how many cups and what sizes. I also loved that they provided all the little essentials (like napkins, corkscrews, etc.), which saved me a lot of hassle. They also gave great advice on having a signature cocktail, which helped direct traffic to one easy-to-serve drink, reducing lines and potentially lowering liquor costs. For our BBQ wedding, they suggested a hard lemonade similar to Del's Frozen Lemonade, and I’m still getting compliments on how delicious it was.

On the day of the wedding, the AYS staff was fantastic. There was never a line, and everyone got what they wanted. They arrived early and set everything up seamlessly. They were also very proactive in recognizing that we were running behind schedule for the cocktail hour and ensured the bar was closed at the right time to accommodate the caterer. When it was time to move the bar to a second location across the property, they handled it effortlessly. I’m not sure the bar ever truly shut down, and it was great.

At the end of the night, everything was neatly packed up. They grouped everything that was mine to keep in one box (including opened items), while they kept returnable items in another. They did a great job of only opening and chilling the minimum number of wine bottles, so we didn’t end up with a ton of leftover stuff to worry about.

Overall, working with AYS was a fantastic experience. On top of the exceptional service, they helped save us a lot of money. We were able to pick exactly the beer and wines we wanted, at the price point we desired, and even return the unopened bottles (we purchased from Total Wine, which I highly recommend). We also got exactly the liquor we wanted without paying inflated prices that many caterers charge. Simple touches, like having buckets of nonalcoholic drinks placed around the property, helped keep the lines down and the costs manageable. I highly recommend their services to anyone. They are an absolute professional team and a joy to work with.

They were a dynamic duo at our wedding! From the very beginning, they were pleasant and fun to work with.  I would absolutely work with them again and highly recommend their services. You guys are awesome!

They really are ‘At Your Service’—they were amazing! From helping us decide on the type of bar we wanted to guiding us on how much to buy, setting up, and cleaning up afterward, they did it all—and then some. They were also so much fun! My sister brews her own beer, and I wanted to serve it at my wedding. AYS was more than happy to accommodate, and I think they became her biggest fans! If you’re looking for a fun and professional team to elevate your wedding, party, or any event, I absolutely recommend AYS!
